script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The joke mixes snoozing, an oven timer and the threatening sword. Its claim that Papa pulled cookies out faster than that also has no clear comparison point.
The welcome-party joke blends the everyday comparison with the sword in the passage and makes the threat itself the punchline.
Papa invents a family reunion. His family is limited to his six cookie cutter kids, and he never invents a reunion.
“Pack light” makes light of people facing exile and the destruction of Memphis.
The suitcase joke does not hold up: someone traveling to battle could pack a bag. The comparison does not click.
The joke mentions snacks, breaking the food rule, and treats exile like a retreat.
A dense forest is not the opposite of a dried-out forest. The verse says nothing about whether the trees are dry.
“I won't joke about this one” comments on how Papa is telling the passage.
The final sentence turns the LORD's words to Jacob into a general assurance that the listener does not need to hide anywhere. The passage does not say that.
